instruction.text: Simple present or present progressive? Select the correct verb form.
instruction.sound: Simple present or present progressive? Select the correct verb form.

atoms.b: As soon as Miriam ((++comes is_coming)) home, she will fill out her application form.

wrong.text: This sentence begins with a secondary clause that starts with <u>as soon as</u>.

atoms.b: If all ((++goes is_going)) well, they will join the basketball team.
After school, she ((plays ++is_playing)) video games with her friends.

wrong.text: This is a planned event or a general estimation of the future, two verb forms can be correct.

atoms.b: We ((have ++are_having)) a school trip to an art museum next Monday.
When the school break finally ((++begins is_beginning)), we will travel to as many towns in our region as possible.

wrong.text: This sentence begins with a secondary clause that starts with <u>when</u>.

instruction.text: Simple present or present progressive? Fill in the correct verb form.
instruction.sound: Simple present or present progressive? Fill in the correct verb form.

atoms.b: They ((are_attending)) a theatre play at the end of the week.
Helena is bound to ((have)) her book published.

wrong.text: The phrase to be bound to requires the infinitive in this case.

atoms.b: Ella ((is_holding)) a coding workshop in the community centre tomorrow.
Noah is likely to ((bake)) a strawberry tart for her friend's birthday.

wrong.text: The phrase to be likely to requires the infinitive in this case.
